title: Two Frames for Five Human Needs: The Quilting Bee and the Trail Club
dek: Where else do people get the things they need at once, without being paid to be there? We listed forty places, developed the ten with the best evidence, and found two that hold all five needs and all four paradoxes: the quilting bee, and the trail club that keeps a long trail open. Each frame also says where it differs from our work.
cover_alt: Frames drawn as rows across five coloured need lines. The top two rows, the quilting bee and the trail club, each have a filled station on all five lines, joined by one bar; below them, ten frames each join two.
